items.title: REVEALED and Hidden in My Heart are now in Study
items.description: Both Scripture-centered resources are listed with Bible studies. Their links remain available, and the games section keeps the other games.

items.title: A simpler way to choose a study, story, or game
items.description: The Learn & Play shortcuts now use clear, compact labels, with the study resources identified before the first study card.

items.title: Home links are now mission section buttons
items.description: The white link-card grid was removed. Our mission and Shop merchandise are buttons in the shared navy mission section; Contact remains in the contact section.

items.title: AWE Missions links now share the mission’s navy background
items.description: The Get to Know section and four homepage cards sit on a continuous navy background with Spreading Christ and the contact section.

items.title: A clearer home page with dedicated pages
items.description: Prayer, Scripture, community outreach, Learn & Play, the Prayer Wall, and updates each have a clear place. The home page keeps its four AWE Missions links.

items.title: Prayer is easier to find on the home page
items.description: The Prayer link was removed from the top menu because the prayer section now leads the home page. Prayer links elsewhere remain available.

items.title: Welcome text now sits below the mission artwork on phones
items.description: The complete AWE Missions image stays clear on mobile; the welcome text appears beneath it on a dark gradient panel.

items.title: A sharper AWE Missions welcome image
items.description: The full-resolution fundraising artwork is optimized for the web, with the AWE Missions logo and dove kept clear above the welcome text.

items.title: A clearer mission banner
items.description: The AWE Missions logo and dove remain uncovered while a dark overlay keeps the welcome text legible.

items.title: A cleaner homepage with AWE Missions branding
items.description: Prayer comes first, followed by the AWE Missions welcome image, then the activity chooser.

items.title: Meet AWE Missions from Explore
items.description: Learn how AWE Missions serves communities and find an optional way to support its outreach right from Explore.

items.title: Story Time is now part of Learn & Play
items.description: Find animated Bible stories alongside daily Bible study and Scripture-centered games, all in one learning section.

items.title: A clearer home and easier discovery
items.description: Explore every AWE Faith activity from a simple directory, use the streamlined menu, and find your recently opened resource.

items.title: Prayer requests can be sent in the app
items.description: Send privately without opening an email app, or choose to submit a request for review before it appears on the Prayer Wall.

items.title: What's New now remembers what you've seen
items.description: Check announcements here and choose whether to see a quiet notice when you revisit.

items.title: Living Word Stories joins AWE Faith
items.description: Watch and listen to the animated retelling of Balaam and his donkey.

items.title: REVEALED is in the games library
items.description: Explore Bible and history challenges along with the other available Scripture-centered games.
